summary: This Form 8-K is a routine current report filed by Bain Capital Specialty Finance, Inc. to announce its first-quarter 2026 financial results and a $0.42 per share dividend for the second quarter. There are no special-situation events such as acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, or any structural changes. The filing serves as a standard earnings release and dividend declaration, which is ordinary course for a publicly traded business development company.
